criteria.criterion: A new unit test in scope_guard.rs shows a request whose text cites jobs of a paused line is in its own line (group_lines) and is not refused as paused; run `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard`.
criteria.evidence: New test `watcher_tests::citing_a_paused_lines_jobs_as_evidence_starts_its_own_line` passed. It pauses the line through the real path (`two_rejections`: ask/go a, then 'try again on a', two T4 rejections), then asks c with the text 'fix disk and resume handling; evidence: jobs {a} and {b} were paused'. It asserts retry_of and same_text_as are None, group_lines == [[0,1],[2]], line_pause(c) == None, that go(&c) gives no 'paused' error, and that c's job record exists, meaning c was dispatched. With the old quotes scan, c would have joined line [0,1], so the grouping assertion would fail.

criteria.criterion: A test shows a retry (retry_of link) of the paused line is still grouped into it and refused; run `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard`, and the existing retry_refuses_paused_line passes.
criteria.evidence: The same new test then asks d = 'try again on {b}'. It asserts retry_of == b, group_lines == [[0,1,3],[2]], and that go(&d) is Err with text containing 'paused' and 'T4'. The existing `retry_refuses_paused_line` also passed in the same run (22 passed, 0 failed).

criteria.criterion: group_lines and request_records in scope_guard.rs no longer link a request to another by job ids found in its text (diff shows the quotes link removed from grouping); doc comments describe grouping by retry link and same-text re-ask only.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: the `quotes` field is removed from RequestRecord, `.chain(r.quotes.iter())` is removed from group_lines, and the `ids` binding and the `quotes: ids...text.contains(...)` block are removed from request_records. Grep for 'quotes' in scope_guard.rs finds nothing. The doc comments on group_lines and request_records now name only the retry link and the same-text re-ask, and say that a job id appearing in a request's text links nothing.

criteria.criterion: Tests that relied on quote grouping (grouping_joins_retries_and_quoting_requests and any others) are updated to the new rule; `cargo test` passes for the whole workspace.
criteria.evidence: `grouping_joins_retries_and_quoting_requests` is renamed `grouping_joins_retries_only` and now expects [[0,2],[1],[3],[4]], with c in its own line. The `req` helper lost its quotes parameter and its callers are updated. Athena's recorded check: `cargo test --locked` passed (1527 tests). In my targeted run both grouping tests passed.
Athena's recorded checks on this tree: `cargo fmt --all --check` passed and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` passed.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing that citing job ids as evidence no longer groups a request into that line (git diff shows it).
criteria.evidence: The diff adds a bullet under Unreleased / Fixed. It says the scope guard no longer groups a request into another line because its text cites that line's job ids, cites the 2026-10-28 refusal, names the root cause (the request_records text scan plus the group_lines join), and states that only the retry link and the same-text re-ask now join a request to a line.

findings.summary: Rewrapped doc comment on group_lines has one line far past the file's usual wrap width.
findings.evidence: The line 'attempts is therefore per line, not per job id. Links to ids not in `requests` are ignored. Returns indices into `requests`; each line is in input order and lines are' is about 170 characters. rustfmt does not wrap comments, so fmt still passes.

findings.summary: One edited line in the design doc is longer than the surrounding wrapped prose.
findings.evidence: The line '(`request_records`: the retry link from "try again on <job>", the re-ask link to an earlier request with the same text, and each job's finished' runs past the doc's wrap width.

summary: The change does what was asked, and I recommend passing it. A request is no longer grouped into another line just because its text mentions that line's job ids. The candidate removes the `quotes` link from scope_guard.rs: the field, the text scan in request_records, and the join in group_lines. Only the retry link and the same-text re-ask now group requests, which fixes the root cause rather than special-casing the one refused request. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard` (22 passed, 0 failed). It includes a new test that pauses a line through the real ask/go flow. In that test, a request citing the paused line's jobs as evidence gets its own line, is not paused and is dispatched, while a 'try again on' retry of the line is grouped into it and refused with T4. The existing retry_refuses_paused_line test also passes. The old grouping test is updated to the new rule. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy -D warnings and full test checks passed. CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased/Fixed entry naming the root cause. The changed files match the expected deliverables, including docs/design/scope-guard.md. The only issues are two nits: a doc comment line and a design-doc line run past the usual wrap width.
